name: Debashish Bordoloi
about: Software engineer and security researcher with strong foundations in full-stack architecture, web security testing, and autonomous AI-assisted development workflows.
Experienced in vulnerability assessment (OWASP Top 10, SSRF defense, authorization flaws), client-side static AST analysis, and distributed search systems.
Passionate about building regional-first multilingual systems, developer tooling with Model Context Protocol (MCP), and sovereign data retrieval.

rea.title: Administrative Architecture & Reverse Engineering Audit
rea.subtitle: Non-Invasive Security Audit of Administrative Surfaces (apssb.online)
rea.tooling: REA v6.8.0, Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), Static AST Chunk Deconstruction
rea.summary: Evidence-backed, non-invasive architectural audit of the administrative system powering apssb.online. Deconstructed client-side route trees and JavaScript bundles to map discovered surfaces, evaluate authentication mechanisms, identify crawler ingestion workflows, and design an enterprise-grade remediation blueprint.
findings: Bifurcated Admin Surface: Public frontend exposes exactly two routes (/admin/current-affairs and /admin/appscce) while exam, test series, and question bank management are completely absent from client bundles.
Authentication Paradigms: Discovered contrast between ad-hoc symmetric header keys (x-admin-key) and 4-hour HTTP-only session cookies (appscce_admin_session).
Autonomous News Crawler: Documented an automated Press Information Bureau (PIB) background parsing and deduplication pipeline.
Security Recommendations: Formulated actionable architectures for Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), multi-factor authentication (MFA), and safe question authoring.

agentSearch.title: Agent Search Engine
agentSearch.subtitle: Distributed, Agent-Native Crawl, Extraction & Hybrid Retrieval Engine
agentSearch.tech: Python 3.12+, FastAPI, Playwright (3-worker pool), PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector, Redis, Trafilatura
agentSearch.summary: Enterprise-grade web crawl and extraction engine purpose-built for autonomous AI agents, LLM toolchains, and RAG pipelines with 100% sovereign link graph discovery and zero external SERP dependencies.
capabilities: 25x Concurrency Pipeline: Async HTTP/2 fetchers with automated headless Playwright Chromium fallback for SPAs and bot challenges.
Precision Extraction & Chunking: Trafilatura readability parser with aggressive XPath boilerplate pruning and sentence-level windowing (≤1000 chars).
Hybrid Vector Search: PostgreSQL 16 pgvector HNSW indexing combined with FastEmbed ONNX (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5) and FlashRank Cross-Encoder reranking.
Native MCP Server: Implements Model Context Protocol via stdio and HTTP/SSE JSON-RPC transports for direct agent tool calling.
Defense in Depth: Pre-flight DNS resolution blocking loopback, link-local, RFC1918 subnets, and cloud metadata (169.254.169.254).
